launch_architecture.transition: Maya moves from founder-only single-deployment operation to a public platform: Studio for creators, Marketplace for listing verified personas, Cloud Runtime hosting many tenants in namespaced isolation, a read-only API for developers, and the Embed runtime as the universal web surface.

scaling_rules: add capacity only when all active slots are above 80% utilization for a committed window
capacity changes are deterministically gated, never reactive guessing

steps: creator applies and passes the eligibility check
creator builds in Studio guided mode (ceiling-locked)

moderation_rules.rule: Ceilings must stay within platform ceilings (CHANNEL_MAX).
Vocabulary must be closed and tone within the allowlist.
Banned directive and financial-guarantee language is grounds for rejection.
No PII or CORED content may appear in any listing or profile.
Personas must be deterministic and produce bounded output in verification.
Market-analyst-category personas must carry the financial-safety ruleset and disclaimer.
Founder review is required before any listing; auto-verify alone is insufficient.

studio.builder_ux: guided persona builder: presets first, only approved knobs exposed, live schema and ceiling feedback

integration_patterns: client-side calls only with a tenant-scoped opaque read token
server-side caching of static persona-info with token rotation
no echo of user-series beyond the in-flight interpretation
onboarding: developer requests a read token for their tenant
token is scoped and opaque; no account or write surface
docs enforce GET-only, rate-limit, and no-PII integration

monitoring: isolation anomaly counters from audit hooks
operations.audit_cycles: daily audit rollup plus a full re-audit at each launch-stage gate
operations.regression_sweeps: re-run the existing verification sweep and isolation 12-step suite on every deploy and at each stage gate
tenant_onboarding: verify company identity and deploy domain config
issue per-tenant embed config and quota
creator_onboarding: first persona submitted and verified before listing
operations.support_model: solo founder continues as primary support through 8.2-8.3; at 8.4 move to operator with authored runbooks and tiered escalation
